steps.title: Define Project Requirements
steps.description: Establish goals for a standard simple application highlighting core Android patterns with zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Create Application Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json declaring 'Very Simple App' and 'com.verysimpleapp.app' as the official identities.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml establishing the main package, MainActivity registration, and launch configurations with proper namespace declarations.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Write build.gradle setting up SDK 34, compile SDK, standard android namespace, and required compile options.

steps.title: Establish Text Resource Strings
steps.description: Create strings.xml containing localizable values for headers, buttons, hints, and feedback messages.

steps.title: Design Color Palette
steps.description: Generate colors.xml to style the app buttons, background, and typography with a material light accent scheme.

steps.title: Design Application Layout
steps.description: Build layout structure using a ScrollView and a centered vertical LinearLayout, introducing a clean dashboard layout.

steps.title: Develop MainActivity Logic
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java handling count operations, text parsing, and standard Anonymous Inner Classes for events.

steps.title: Verify State Persistence Logic
steps.description: Add lifecycle logic within MainActivity.java to save and restore instance state when screen orientation changes.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and Schema Settings
steps.description: Review AndroidManifest.xml and resource directories ensuring proper XML schemas and package path mapping.

steps.title: Building Very Simple App
steps.description: Trigger local compilation using Gradle 8.5 tools to bundle layouts, resources, and binary objects into a final debug APK.
